_comment: Shape of the 'fleet' field at op://homelab/topology/fleet.
This file is an EXAMPLE. The real one lives in 1Password as a single
multiline field holding this JSON, because site topology for an MSP is
reconnaissance material - client names, network ranges and hypervisor
addresses - and does not belong in a repository.
Adding a hypervisor is appending to a site's nodes array.
Adding a site is adding a key. Nothing else changes.
The octet is the site's identity on the overlay network: it owns
10.<octet>.0.0/16. It must be unique, and must never be recycled - routes
for a retired site can linger and would start pointing somewhere new.
Stay below 96, since Kubernetes defaults use 10.96.0.0/12 and 10.244.0.0/16.
